content.rendered: The Hawks View Cinco de Mayo Spring Carnival is coming up fast! Mark your calendars for May 5th, 4:00-8:00pm. It’s an exciting evening of fun for the whole family! Skip the lines and pre-order your activity punch cards. Click HERE for the flyer with more information. We hope to see you there!
